instruction.text: You’re talking to Sadie. Fill in the gaps to learn about how she lives sustainably.

atoms.b: Hi Sadie! Do you have any tips for ((++sustainability dancing)) in your daily life?
I practise sustainability by ((++following ignoring)) the 5 Rs.
atoms.sound: I practise sustainability by following the 5 arz.

atoms.b: You should first consider whether you actually need an item, or if you are able to ((++refuse race)) it.
If you do need it, you should ((++reduce steal)) how much you use, reuse the item again, or ((++repurpose read)) it for something else if possible.
Once the item cannot be used in any other way, you should dispose of it properly by ((++recycling releasing)) it.
Wow, that’s really interesting. Thanks, Sadie!

instruction.text: Help Sadie make the sustainable choice based on the 5 Rs.

Sadie is at the supermarket choosing between fruit and veg with or without plastic packaging. What should she do?

b.sound: reduce her plastic waste by choosing the unpackaged products
buy the products with plastic packaging

atoms.a: Sadie has just finished drinking from a plastic bottle of water. What should she do?

b.sound: reuse it by filling it up again

atoms.a: Sadie has an empty glass jar left over from cooking dinner. What should she do?
Sadie has a lot of rubbish collecting in her room. What should she do?

b.sound: recycle it in the correct bins
throw it all in the same bin
